Early C2C12 Growth

Dr. Sara J. Smith

14 September, 2026

Load Libraries & Data

Load necessary libraries and data, clean and refactor data.

Myogenin Expression

Modelling

myo.mod <- lmer(deltacq ~ condition*day + (1|trial), data = myo)
## fixed-effect model matrix is rank deficient so dropping 3 columns / coefficients
myo.res <- simulateResiduals(myo.mod)
plot(myo.res)

summary(myo.mod)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]
## Formula: deltacq ~ condition * day + (1 | trial)
##    Data: myo
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: 127.6
## 
## Scaled residuals:

## -1.95672 -0.57724 -0.00758  0.63637  1.60073 
## 
## Random effects:

##  trial    (Intercept) 1.1800   1.0863  
##  Residual             0.9043   0.9509  
## Number of obs: 46, groups:  trial, 6

## condition2FBS        1.7516     0.5793 32.0704   3.024  0.00489 ** 
## condition2HS         1.3537     0.5805 32.1359   2.332  0.02612 *  
## day1                -4.2556     0.5490 31.9806  -7.751 7.75e-09 ***
## day2                -6.3844     0.5490 31.9806 -11.629 5.04e-13 ***
## condition10HS:day1   1.2158     0.8451 32.0383   1.439  0.15996    
## condition2FBS:day1  -0.1254     0.8452 32.0422  -0.148  0.88294    
## condition2HS:day1    1.0471     0.8143 31.9806   1.286  0.20772

## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) cn10HS cn2FBS cnd2HS day1   day2   c10HS: c2FBS:
## conditn10HS  0.000                                                 
## conditn2FBS  0.000  0.444                                          
## conditin2HS  0.000  0.463  0.444                                   
## day1        -0.466  0.000  0.000  0.000                            
## day2        -0.466 -0.473 -0.474 -0.473  0.500                     
## cndtn10HS:1  0.000 -0.676 -0.310 -0.307 -0.325  0.325              
## cndtn2FBS:1  0.000 -0.311 -0.677 -0.311 -0.325  0.325  0.430       
## cndtn2HS:d1  0.000 -0.319 -0.319 -0.701 -0.337  0.337  0.438  0.438
## fit warnings:
## fixed-effect model matrix is rank deficient so dropping 3 columns / coefficients

  • Intercept: Represents the predicted deltacq value for the 10FBS condition at Day MB

  • Condition effects (at Day MB): Compared to 10FBS at the MB time point, deltacq is significantly higher across all other media

  • Day effects (in 10FBS): Relative to Day MB, deltacq significantly decreases over time within the baseline 10FBS condition

  • Condition * Day interactions: None of the condition:day1 interaction terms are strong. This indicates that the change in deltacq from Day MB to Day 1 in 10HS, 2FBS, and 2HS is not meaningfully different from the drop observed in 10FBS.

  • All condition:day2 terms were automatically dropped because of the model matrix rank deficiency. Model is built in order of Intercept, Main Effects, then Interactions, which “uses up” all available degrees of freedom before getting to day 2 in interaction terms

Let’s try a model without MB to capture a full factorial design:

myo.diff <- myo %>%
  filter(day == "1" | day == "2")
  
myo.diff.mod <- lmer(deltacq ~ condition * day + (1 | trial), data = myo.diff)
myo.diff.res <- simulateResiduals(myo.diff.mod)
plot(myo.diff.res)

summary(myo.diff.mod)

## conditn10HS -0.380                                          
## conditn2FBS -0.381  0.389                                   
## conditin2HS -0.408  0.433  0.404                            
## day2        -0.433  0.439  0.440  0.472

  • Intercept: Represents the baseline predicted deltacq for 10FBS on Day 1.

  • Day 1 Condition effects: On Day 1, all test conditions show significantly higher deltacq values compared to the baseline 10FBS

  • Time (day 1 to day 2): In the 10FBS baseline condition, deltacq significantly decreases by 2.13 units from Day 1 to Day 2.

  • Condition * Day interactions: None of the interaction terms exhibit differences. This indicates that the rate of change from Day 1 to Day 2 in 10HS, 2FBS, and 2HS does not meaningfully differ from 10FBS.

New model Sept 14 2026

The interaction term in the previous model (myo.diff.mod) was not significant, and therefore we can drop the interaction term, model just fixed effects and extract estimated marginal means from that model instead.

myo.diff.mod2 <- lmer(deltacq ~ condition + day + (1 | trial), data = myo.diff)
myo.diff.res2 <- simulateResiduals(myo.diff.mod2)
plot(myo.diff.res2)
## Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L,
## : Fitting terminated with step failure - check results carefully

AIC(myo.diff.mod, myo.diff.mod2) # effectively equal
df AIC
myo.diff.mod 10 128.4604
myo.diff.mod2 7 130.3809

Extracting estimated marginal means

myo.cond.emmeans <- emmeans(myo.diff.mod2, pairwise ~ condition)
myo.cond.emmeans
## $emmeans
##  condition emmean    SE   df lower.CL upper.CL
##  10FBS       4.66 0.540 7.03     3.38     5.93
##  10HS        6.84 0.569 8.43     5.54     8.14
##  2FBS        6.35 0.567 8.38     5.05     7.65
##  2HS         6.54 0.559 7.92     5.24     7.83
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: day 
## Degrees-of-freedom method: kenward-roger 
## Confidence level used: 0.95 
## 
## $contrasts
##  contrast     estimate    SE   df t.ratio p.value
##  10FBS - 10HS   -2.182 0.413 30.4  -5.283 <0.0001
##  10FBS - 2FBS   -1.694 0.411 30.2  -4.124  0.0015
##  10FBS - 2HS    -1.880 0.400 30.4  -4.704  0.0003
##  10HS - 2FBS     0.488 0.452 30.7   1.080  0.7041
##  10HS - 2HS      0.302 0.421 30.1   0.716  0.8898
##  2FBS - 2HS     -0.186 0.442 30.8  -0.421  0.9744
## 
## Results are averaged over the levels of: day 
## Degrees-of-freedom method: kenward-roger 
## P value adjustment: tukey method for comparing a family of 4 estimates
myo.day.emmeans <- emmeans(myo.diff.mod2, pairwise ~ day)
myo.day.emmeans

Visualization

Colour palette for MB, Day 1, Day 2 NB: can convert all colour palettes to a colourblind or grey scale friendly palette

day.cols <- pnw_palette(name = "Starfish", n = 3, type = "discrete")

Myogenin expression

ggplot(myo, aes(x = day, y = deltacq, fill = day, colour = day)) +
  geom_jitter() + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = day.cols) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = day.cols) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Myogenin ΔCq") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 13))

p21 Expression

Significant comparisons:

  • 10FBS - 2HS (<0.001)
  • 10HS - 2FBS (<0.001)
  • 10HS - 2 HS (<0.001)

Visualization

Colour palette for conditions (10FBS, 10HS, 2FBS, 2HS)

cond.cols <- pnw_palette(name = "Sunset", n = 4, type = "discrete")
ggplot(cfi, aes(x = condition, y = cfi, fill = condition, colour = condition)) +
  geom_jitter() + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cond.cols) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond.cols) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Cell Fusion Index (CFI)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 110))

Note: this x-axis can be rearranged depending on what order you want the conditions to be presented in

Myotube Diameter

Modelling

diam.lmod <- lmer(diameter ~ condition*day + (1|trial), data = diam)
diam.lres <- simulateResiduals(diam.lmod)
plot(diam.lres) # lots of issues

Distribution fitting

ggplot(diam, aes(x = diameter)) + 
  geom_histogram() # looks gamma-y
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.

fit.gamma <- fitdist(diam$diameter, "gamma")
fit.lnorm <- fitdist(diam$diameter, "lnorm")
fit.norm <- fitdist(diam$diameter, "norm")
plot(fit.gamma)

plot(fit.lnorm)

plot(fit.norm)

denscomp(list(fit.gamma, fit.norm, fit.lnorm), legendtext = c("Gamma", "Normal", "Lognormal"))

gofstat(list(fit.norm, fit.gamma, fit.lnorm))$aic
##  1-mle-norm 2-mle-gamma 3-mle-lnorm 
##    8489.909    8328.717    8311.932
#lognormal it is

Modelling

diam.mod <- lmer(log(diameter) ~ condition * day + (1|trial), data = diam)
diam.res <- simulateResiduals(diam.mod)
plot(diam.res)

summary(diam.mod)

## condition2FBS:day12   0.43333    0.06695 850.09362   6.472 1.63e-10 ***
## condition2HS:day12    0.32713    0.06850 850.00962   4.776 2.11e-06 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

##             (Intr) cn10HS cn2FBS cnd2HS day12  c10HS: c2FBS:
## conditn10HS -0.511                                          
## conditn2FBS -0.558  0.481                                   
## conditin2HS -0.535  0.462  0.504                            
## day12       -0.540  0.467  0.508  0.489                     
## cndt10HS:12  0.366 -0.716 -0.345 -0.331 -0.677              
## cndt2FBS:12  0.385 -0.332 -0.689 -0.347 -0.711  0.482       
## cndtn2HS:12  0.376 -0.325 -0.354 -0.702 -0.696  0.471  0.495

  • Intercept: Represents the baseline predicted diameter for 10FBS at Day 7. Untransformed, is e^4.43 ~= 83.3 mu (microns).

  • Condition main effects (compared to 10FBS on day 7): myotubes in 10HS are significantly larger in diameter, and myotubes in 2FBS are significantly smaller in diameter.

  • Time main effect (10FBS over time): myotubes in 10FBS significantly decrease in diameter by day 12

  • Condition * Day interactions (differences between day 7 & day 12):

    • myotubes in 2FBS & 2HS show significant increase in diameter
    • myotubes in 10HS do not differ in behaviour significantly from 10FBS. Since myotubes in 10FBS significantly decrease between day 7 and day 12 (see Time main effect above), so to do mytoubes in 10HS

  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", alpha = 0.8) + 
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = condition), linewidth = 1, lty = 2) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1, alpha = 0.8) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond.cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond.cols) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Myotube Diameter (μm)", colour = "Condition", fill = "Condition") +
